pre_registration.measures: positional bias only — the eligibility precondition, not a preference.
pre_registration.power: Deliberately a screen. At the default 32 comparisons the standard error on a bias estimate is about 0.088, which separates a 0.80-biased judge from an unbiased one at roughly 3.4 standard errors and does NOT resolve a candidate sitting near the band edge. A candidate that lands inside the band here is a candidate worth funding a real arm on, never a candidate that has passed.
pre_registration.reserved: Which cross-family judge is acceptable — cost, terms, protocol fidelity — is the operator's call (directive §6). This module narrows the field to the eligible; it does not choose from it.
pre_registration.withholding_rule: Win rates are computed and NOT reported for any candidate whose bias falls outside the band. A preference read off a positionally-biased judge is what §83, §85's em-dash arm and §79.1 each had to void, and printing one here would also pre-empt the operator's reserved choice of cross-family judge.
